cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recruits tidying and A3 reveals replacement, but A3 authority label never changes the recruitment method.

relationship.evidence: B2 willing labour becomes B4 legitimate refusal of a political mandate.

heightening.evidence: A5 repeats the recruitment rather than making B4 objection materially change the proposal.
